verdict.rationale: Claude Code explicitly supports natural-language driven debugging: it can 'debug live web applications' via Chrome integration, do 'overnight CI failure analysis', explain/map entire codebases via agentic search, and resolve issues like merge conflicts and lint errors from plain-language prompts. Community reports corroborate real-world use for multi-language debugging tasks, though other reports note inconsistent quality on complex tasks. Missing for 10: independent benchmark/hands-on validation specifically isolating debugging accuracy (vs general coding quality complaints in community threads).
